tools.name: make_meme
tools.description: Turn a sentence into finished memes. Memeoki picks classic, well-known templates (Drake, Distracted Boyfriend, This Is Fine and 1800+ more) that fit the situation and writes fresh captions in the right format. Use it whenever someone asks for a meme, a reaction image or a funny way to say something.

tools.name: caption_template
tools.description: Put your own exact words on one classic template. Instant, no AI involved. Use search_templates first to get the template id and its caption slots. captions can be an object (slot -> text) or a list of strings in slot order. Example: template "drake", captions ["Writing tests", "Shipping on Friday"]

tools.name: search_templates
tools.description: Search 1800+ classic meme templates by name, nickname or idea ("drake", "distracted", "choice", "panic"). Returns each template's id, caption slots (with what goes in each), what the meme means, example captions and a blank image. Use before caption_template.
